evidence: Co.ai, a proprietary suite of total loss determination and valuation tools that leverage machine learning and computer vision to assist sellers in the vehicle claims evaluation process

IntelliSeller, an automated tool leveraging our vast and detailed vehicle and sales data to assist our sellers in making vital auction decisions. Using machine learning, IntelliSeller optimizes the utilization of our vehicle and sales data

We continue to evaluate emerging technologies like artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative artificial intelligence for incorporation into our business to augment our products and services

If competitors introduce new services embodying new technologies or if new industry standards and practices emerge such as the increased use of artificial intelligence, machine learning and generative artificial intelligence, our existing websites and proprietary technology and systems may become obsolete
ai_positioning.summary: CPRT intègre le machine learning et la computer vision dans ses produits (Co.ai, IntelliSeller) pour optimiser les décisions de vente et d'évaluation, tout en restant vigilant face aux risques concurrentiels liés à l'évolution rapide des technologies IA.
